races.title: Overton Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: CHUGGY is in the perfect hands to kick on as a second-season chaser and it's not hard to envisage him returning with a bang and making all here. Wandering Ego is sure to step up on his chasing debut effort, while Laguna Beach commands respect tackling the larger obstacles for the first time. CHUGGY WANDERING EGO (IRE) LAGUNA BEACH (FR)
races.bettingForecast: Chuggy (15/8), Laguna Beach (9/4), Wandering Ego (10/3), Bowenspark (6/1), Supreme George (12/1)

races.title: Yorton Mares' Novices' Chase (Listed) (GBB Race)
races.verdict: This has a very open look to it but MIGHTY FLEUR arrives here on a roll and with race fitness and chasing experience on her side, that may count for plenty as she tackles a step up in grade. Jubilee Alpha was just about the best of these over hurdles so it will be interesting to see what Faye Bramley can do with her, while Sunset Marquesa is another nice prospect over the larger obstacles. MIGHTY FLEUR JUBILEE ALPHA (IRE) SUNSET MARQUESA (IRE)
races.bettingForecast: Jubilee Alpha (5/2), Sunset Marquesa (4/1), Siog Geal (9/2), Piper Park (6/1), Mighty Fleur (7/1), Onefournine (8/1), Getawhisky (10/1), Merely A Detail (33/1)

races.title: Weatherbys & Birdie Calendars Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: FIRST CONFESSION found 3¾m too much of a test at Cheltenham when last seen in March but back over a more suitable trip in a lesser handicap, he could get on the up returning for his in-form stable. Broomfields Cave and Arizona Cardinal also reappear, the latter from a huge lay-off but both are interesting. FIRST CONFESSION (IRE) BROOMFIELDS CAVE (IRE) ARIZONA CARDINAL
races.bettingForecast: Broomfields Cave (13/8), Jupiter Allen (2/1), Blenkinsop (4/1), Arizona Cardinal (8/1), First Confession (10/1)

races.title: Bangor-On-Dee Memberships Now On Sale EBF Junior 'National Hunt' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: A field consisting of 7 newcomers, with preference going to ROCKSON PIEL , a Harry Derham-trained half-brother to the useful hurdler Steel Ally. Agafay is highly respected for the Greatrex yard, whilst Fika also makes appeal on paper. ROCKSON PIEL (FR) AGAFAY (FR) FIKA
races.bettingForecast: Agafay (5/2), Fika (11/4), Rockson Piel (10/3), Notre Jacques (15/2), Royal Castle (10/1), Bump And Run (12/1), Sam's Reflection (12/1)

races.title: Paul Ferguson's Jumpers To Follow Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Assuming he takes to hurdling at the first attempt, useful Flat recruit ALCARATH is expected to outclass these. Sears Crossing and Frost Moon may be of more interest further down the line but can still make their presence felt at this level. ALCARATH (IRE) SEARS CROSSING (IRE) FROST MOON (IRE)
races.bettingForecast: Alcarath (5/4), Frost Moon (7/2), Hang Out (4/1), Sky Grove (7/1), Sears Crossing (10/1), Dolly Drama (20/1), Get Busy Jumping (25/1), Whiteoak Duffy (100/1)

races.title: Wrexham Lager Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: SOLID PERFORMER has shown more than enough to think a race of this nature is within his grasp and he holds excellent claims on seasonal bow. Mr Rafiki comfortably rates the chief danger to Donald McCain's 8-y-o. SOLID PERFORMER (IRE) MR RAFIKI (IRE) CAPTAIN CONNOR (FR)
races.bettingForecast: Solid Performer (10/11), Mr Rafiki (2/1), Ar Ais Aris (5/2), Captain Connor (15/2), Granny B (8/1)

races.title: Festive Meeting Saturday 28th November Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: There should be plenty more to come from BROOKSIDE LA this season and in receipt of weight all round, he looks the way to go after an impressive performance at Worcester. Charisma Cat and The Cistercian are feared most. BROOKSIDE LA (IRE) CHARISMA CAT THE CISTERCIAN (IRE)
races.bettingForecast: Charisma Cat (13/8), Good To Be Alive (11/4), Brookside La (4/1), Static (13/2), The Cistercian (7/1)
